The '''Keren Bank''' was a [[Bank/Legends|bank]] located in the city of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]], on the world [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="AED" />

==History==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer sent by [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] visited the Keren Bank to retrieve one of the pieces of a broken [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] artifact scattered by the [[Ultragungans]] in various areas of Naboo.<ref name="SWG:RaSPotsGA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Recover all Six Pieces of the scattered Gungan Artifact|Naboo}}</ref>
